beats.label: S1 · Plane crash
beats.text: A plane crash kills Preston Clyburn and his brother Paul, and widow Stacy brings her New York family to the Montana ranch the brothers loved.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The inciting loss that pulls the family west and frames every choice Stacy makes.

beats.label: S1 · Choosing Montana
beats.text: Guilty for having dismissed Preston's attachment to the ranch, Stacy meets kind neighbor Cade Harris and decides to leave New York and stay permanently.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First shift of Stacy's centre of gravity from NYC to the valley, and Cade's entrance.

beats.label: S1 · Abigail meets Van
beats.text: Family tensions boil over; Stacy pressures Abigail to stay or lose her support. Storming out, Abigail is picked up by Deputy Van Davis and they fall for each other.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Van and the cross-world romance that will keep pulling Abigail back to Montana.

beats.label: S1 · Liliana and the recorder
beats.text: Best friend Liliana arrives from New York to help. Van shares recovered flight-recorder audio of the brothers' final words as he and Abigail grow closer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants Liliana as Stacy's NYC tether and deepens the two threads driving the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Funeral and retreat
beats.text: Preston and Paul are buried on ranch land above the Madison River. Van reluctantly ends things with Abigail, and Stacy dutifully flies her family back to New York.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both the ranch commitment and the Van–Abigail romance are seemingly closed here, setting up their reversal.

beats.label: S1 · Grief in New York
beats.text: Preston's journal reveals Paul's own hidden struggles with grief. Paige strikes a coworker who mocks Preston, and Stacy's therapist urges her to follow her instincts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows New York cannot hold the family and sets up Stacy's flight from the memorial.

beats.label: S1 · Return to the ranch
beats.text: Stacy skips Liliana's memorial and vanishes into the night. Cade finds her asleep beside Preston's grave in Montana, where she declares she has come back to stay.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's true choice: Stacy leaves her old life for good, alone, with Cade as the one waiting.

cliffhanger.text: Stacy has walked out on her New York life for good and returned alone to the ranch beside Preston's grave, with her daughters and their families still back east and Cade the only person beside her.
questions: Will Abigail, Paige and the rest of the family follow Stacy to Montana or stay in New York?
Can Stacy build a life on the ranch on her own terms without Preston to anchor her?
Is the door truly closed on Abigail and Van, or will she find her way back to him?

characters.name: Stacy Clyburn
characters.line: New York widow of Preston who has abandoned her old life and returned to the Madison Valley ranch to stay.

characters.name: Abigail Clyburn
characters.line: Stacy's eldest daughter, drifting after her father's death and her brief Montana romance with Van being cut off.

characters.name: Paige Clyburn
characters.line: Stacy's other daughter, volatile and raw with grief, recently arrested-worthy for punching a coworker who insulted Preston.

characters.name: Cade Harris
characters.line: Native American neighbor who has quietly befriended Stacy, brought the family food, and found her asleep at Preston's grave.

characters.name: Van Davis
characters.line: Local deputy sheriff who fell for Abigail but ended the relationship at the funeral, judging their worlds too far apart.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.line: Stacy's New York best friend, who organised Preston's memorial and steered her to the therapist whose advice sent her back to Montana.

characters.name: Preston Clyburn
characters.line: Stacy's late husband, buried above the Madison River; his journal is still guiding the family's choices from beyond the grave.
